README:

Mission: Drop efficiently the misbehaving crawlers
License: AGPL
Project start date: 2026-09-29

Features:
- using eBPF to drop fast the IPs which are misbehaving
- resume misbehaving IPs list if an interruption occurs
- supportes a tree like architecture with upstream and downstreams

Presentation (built from 'docs' folder):
https://rocketgit.com/user/catalinux/ai-drop/artefacts/download/docs/pre1.pdf

Installation (automatic, easy update, recommended):
To install ai-drop as a package, visit:
https://rocketgit.com/user/catalinux/ai-drop/pkg

Installation (manual, not recommended):
# Look inside ai-drop.spec or debian/control and install the dependencies.
./configure
make
make install
# edit /etc/ai-drop.conf
# Very important:
# set 'interface' (non 'eth' are not supported now)
# set safe_mode to 0 if you only want to evaluate the product.

After installation:
systemctl enable --now ai-drop
journalctl -f -u ai-drop

# Look at the statistics, especially 'drops':
ai-drop dump-stats

Hints:
Before first commit, do not forget to setup your git environment:

git config --global user.name "your_name_here"
git config --global user.email "your@email_here"

Clone this repository using HTTP(S):

git clone https://rocketgit.com/user/catalinux/ai-drop

Clone this repository using ssh (do not forget to upload a key first):

git clone ssh://rocketgit@ssh.rocketgit.com/user/catalinux/ai-drop

Clone this repository using git:

git clone git://git.rocketgit.com/user/catalinux/ai-drop

You are allowed to anonymously push to this repository.
This means that your pushed commits will automatically be transformed into a merge request:

... clone the repository ...
... make some changes and some commits ...
git push origin main
